title: Christmas Bundle
author: PixelTemplix
description:
Christmas SVG Bundle has everything for your Christmas crafting projects!
This Bundle Includes 20 Designs
This is a digital product no physical product will be sent.
ZIP File includes SVG, PNG, DXF, PDF, JPG and EPS formats of the cut file, compatible for use with Silhouette and Cricut machines, as well as other machines that can read these formats.
fullDescription:
Christmas SVG Bundle has everything for your Christmas crafting projects!

This Bundle Includes 20 Designs

This is a digital product no physical product will be sent.

ZIP File includes SVG, PNG, DXF, PDF, JPG and EPS formats of the cut file, compatible for use with Silhouette and Cricut machines, as well as other machines that can read these formats.
